The biopsy results showing hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, solar elastosis, and atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis confirm the clinical diagnosis of Actinic Keratosis. This is consistent with the rough, scaly plaque observed on your left dorsal hand.
